parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_sku)
       product_sku, title, brand, category,
       price_amount, currency, stock_status, promo_text,
       attributes,
       CASE WHEN title ILIKE $1 THEN 'title' ELSE 'attributes' END AS matched_in
  FROM tecbite_product_state
 WHERE is_active = true
   AND (title ILIKE $1 OR attributes::text ILIKE $1)
 ORDER BY product_sku,
          CASE stock_status WHEN 'in_stock' THEN 1 WHEN 'out_of_stock' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
          price_amount ASC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 10;
